**Personal** dotfiles with [**Material Design**](https://m3.material.io/) colors generated by [**Matugen**](https://github.com/InioX/matugen) based on the wallpaper.

```bash
sudo pacman -S --needed yadm &&
yadm clone "https://github.com/DimitryGonzales/dotfiles-hyprland.git" &&
yadm checkout --force
```
